_comment: The ambient bed under a match (source/match/environment/AmbientBed.gd). One tier bed per city tier of the player on screen, crossfaded when the city grows, and two threat layers on top that follow the music's state (MusicPlayer: CALM, TENSION, BATTLE). gain is the layer's full loudness (linear, 0..1, on the Ambience bus; the tier beds are matched to about -29 LUFS, tension -26, battle -24); levels scale each layer per music state. Low oil brings a quiet tension layer from the industrial tier on. The loops come from tools/audio/make_ambient_beds.py.
_comment_fades: seconds to fade a layer fully in or out: threat comes quickly, calm returns slowly
_comment_zoom: zoomed all the way out the bed is this much louder, as the local sounds fade
